raw_response.rationale: All three materials are available before the 2026-01-03 cutoff. The target's source, notice-g-v1, cites record-g, and that primary measurement record states the result was 25 units, not 30. The same notice was then corrected on 2026-01-02 (notice-g-v2), explicitly retracting the 30-unit figure and aligning with the record's 25 units. The original notice is the only material stating 30 units, it is a downstream report of a record that says otherwise, and its own issuer has withdrawn the figure, so there is no unresolved opposition. The eligible evidence settles the claim against the target.
